8.3.1.2 E2E_P01ProtectInit
[SWS_E2E_00385] Definition of API function E2E_P01ProtectInit
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08539, RS_E2E_08527
⌈
Service Name
E2E_P01ProtectInit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P01ProtectInit (
E2E_P01ProtectStateType* StatePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1b
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
StatePtr
Pointer to port/data communication state.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E2E_E_INPUTERR_NULL - null pointer passed
E2E_E_OK
Description
Initializes the protection state.
Available via
E2E.h
⌋
[SWS_E2E_00386]
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08528
⌈In case State is NULL, E2E_P01ProtectInit shall return immediately with E2E_E_
INPUTERR_NULL. Otherwise, it shall initialize the state structure, setting Counter to
0.⌋
